textbookBox.concept: Can two lines intersect with all four angles equal? Four equal angles that make a full turn of 360 degrees must each be 90 degrees.

beats.en: Can two lines intersect with all four angles equal? Four equal angles that make a full turn of 360 degrees must each be 90 degrees. Lines that intersect at right angles are called perpendicular lines.
beats.speakEn: Can two lines intersect with all four angles equal? Four equal angles that make a full turn of 360 degrees must each be 90 degrees. Lines that intersect at right angles are called perpendicular lines.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 maths · Parallel and Intersecting Lines · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Fold a square sheet in half horizontally. The crease is parallel to the top and bottom edges. Fold again and you get more parallel creases. A vertical fold is perpendicular to the horizontal edges.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Parallel and Intersecting Lines: Fold a square sheet in half horizontally. The crease is parallel to the top and bottom edges. Fold again and you get more parallel creases. A vertical fold is perpendicular to the horizontal edges.
